Research LMS@Hunimed MyPORTAL Alumni Home / Student Services EN IT Menu Student Services Student Office IT Services Library Spiritual Assistant Counseling Mentorship DSA The Humanitas University campus is designed to offer students a welcoming, modern and functional environment for both study and daily life. Every space is intended to support not only academic growth but also personal well‑being and the opportunity to fully enjoy the university experience. Well‑maintained facilities, dedicated study and social areas, support services and numerous student initiatives make the campus a pleasant and stimulating place where you can feel part of an international community. Particular attention is paid to quality of daily life : a dedicated app allows users to report any needs or faults so that spaces remain functional, safe and enjoyable. Campus Life therefore means studying in a dynamic, well‑managed setting where learning is complemented by personal development, well‑being and shared experiences. Student Office The Student Office is the point of reference for all needs related to administrative and academic matters. Students can visit the office during opening hours or contact it through the dedicated channels (phone, email, or certified email) to receive support and assistance. Student Office Monday, Wednesday, Friday from 9.00am to 12.30pm Tuesday and Thursday from 2pm to 5pm Email: info@hunimed.eu Certified Email: areastudentihu@pec.it Phone: +39 02 8224 3777 IT Services The IT Systems Unit is responsible for the management and development of the University’s information systems in support of teaching, research and administrative processes. Through its professional staff it promotes the effective use of new technologies, oversees the University’s ICT services and provides assistance and support to users. It ensures the development and improvement of information systems, enables users to access and use advanced technologies, applications, information and services, and promotes the effective and efficient acquisition and use of ICT infrastructure and technologies. Services The University’s information systems provide various services to students, academic staff and administrative personnel: Access to software (Matlab, Stata) University Wi‑Fi Eduroam federated Wi‑Fi network E-learning Access to applications Digital learning Support The University operates an IT Help Desk service for students, academic staff and all administrative personnel to resolve issues related to services, applications and IT equipment managed by the IT Systems Unit. Students also have access to an on‑site technical support service, the “IT Corner,” staffed by a technician by appointment via the dedicated app. Discover IT Services IDEM GARR Library Established in 1996, the Humanitas Research Hospital Library became a Scientific Documentation Centre in 2007 to promote and support research, clinical care, teaching and learning needs. Learn More Spiritual Assistant Don Mattia Bernasconi – Spiritual Assistant of Humanitas University and parish vicar at the Visitazione della Beata Vergine Maria community in Gratosoglio. Don Mattia is on campus Monday to Friday. To book an appointment, contact him at mattia.bernasconi@hunimed.eu. Counselling Service The counselling service is a free service provided by Humanitas University offering students a short course of psychological support. In meetings with the psychologists who work with the service, students can explore issues or difficulties that cause worry, stress or distress in a safe, welcoming and non‑judgemental environment. What kind of issues can be addressed through counselling? Problems related to university life (for example: study methods, organisation and planning, stress associated with exam periods); Personal difficulties (for example: adjusting to relocation, adapting to a new environment and lifestyle…); Relational difficulties (for example: periods of crisis in friendships, family relationships, or romantic relationships…); Stressful events affecting psychological well‑being (losses, bereavement, etc…). How are counselling programmes structured? The programme usually consists of five sessions , which may be extended if the practitioners consider it necessary. Sessions are held fortnightly and can take place either face‑to‑face at Humanitas University or online . Each session lasts 45 minutes. How can I book an appointment? You can book an appointment by e-mailing counselingservice@hunimed.eu Mentorship Service The student mentorship programme is organised and supported by Humanitas University under the supervision of the Office for Medical Education and the International Student Office. What is peer mentorship? The mentoring programme matches junior students (mentees) with senior or more experienced students (mentors), who act as advisers and guides, providing support and feedback to the mentee. What is the role of mentors? Mentors support junior students by answering questions about university life (both curricular and extracurricular activities), sharing relevant experiences and providing students with contacts they may need. How is student peer mentorship organised at Humanitas University? Each year, incoming students are connected with a group of second‑year tutors via the LMS online platform, where students can ask questions, form groups or request individual appointments. This peer‑mentoring programme supports students throughout the six‑year degree course. For more information about the mentorship service, e-mail to officeformedicaleducation@hunimed.eu. Services for students with disabilities or specific learning disorders (SLD) Humanitas University has a Service for Students with Disabilities and SLD that provides orientation upon entry to the University and support throughout the course of study, with the aim of identifying and designing the types of assistance each student needs to successfully complete their programme. By registering with the Service for Students with Disabilities and SLD, students receive counselling supported by a neuro-psychologist specialised in SLD. Students discuss and define their needs and the necessary support measures in a tailored manner and in accordance with the CNUDD guidelines. The service also provides a handbook with practical and useful advice. Learn more Humanitas University is an international medical school based in Milan, built alongside the renowned Humanitas Research and Teaching Hospital. in Hunimed Rivolta agli studenti Erasmus incoming in partenza per Milano, questa sezione mette a disposizione indicazioni pratiche per completare in modo corretto tutte le procedure amministrative. Per poter svolgere a uno scambio in Humanitas University è necessaria l’esistenza di un Accordo Erasmus+ tra HU e il tuo ateneo di provenienza, dal quale dovrai essere ufficialmente nominato. International Office Email: international.office@hunimed.eu Telefono: 02 8224 2486 Orario: Lunedì – Giovedì dalle 9:00 alle 18:00 Erasmus+ Erasmus+ è il programma dell’Unione Europea che permette agli studenti di frequentare corsi, sostenere esami e tesi, partecipare a ricerche, laboratori ed esperienze cliniche nelle università partner europee, con successivo riconoscimento accademico di tutte le attività svolte durante il percorso formativo. L’obiettivo principale del programma è offrire agli studenti l’opportunità di migliorare la conoscenza di una lingua straniera e di formarsi in un contesto interculturale, contribuendo così allo sviluppo della società europea. Durante il periodo di mobilità all’estero gli studenti rimangono iscritti al proprio Ateneo di origine e non devono corrispondere tasse o rette presso Humanitas University (ad eccezione di eventuali spese di segreteria). Accordi Erasmus+ Humanitas University ha sottoscritto accordi Erasmus+ con le seguenti università partner: Université de Lausanne – Losanna, Svizzera (codice Erasmus: CH LAUSANN01) Universidad Francisco de Vitoria – Madrid, Spagna (codice Erasmus: E MADRID28) Universitat Internacional de Catalunya – Barcellona, Spagna (codice Erasmus: EBARCELO24) Studenti in Entrata da Università Partner Requisiti Chiunque intenda partecipare a un periodo di scambio presso l’Ateneo nell’ambito del Programma Internazionale di Medicina (interamente in lingua inglese) deve soddisfare i seguenti requisiti: Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello B1 QCER Conoscenza della lingua italiana almeno a livello B1 QCER, necessaria per interagire con i pazienti Almeno tre anni di studio nel corso di laurea in Medicina Capacità di condurre anamnesi ed esame clinico di un paziente Gli studenti devono presentare un certificato ufficiale della propria università di provenienza che attesti il livello linguistico richiesto. Opzioni di studio Gli studenti in mobilità possono accedere a corsi di Medicina (vedi piano di studi completo con ECTS associati a ciascun esame). Rotazioni cliniche, disponibili durante tutto l’anno accademico (escluso agosto), in base alla disponibilità dei reparti. Struttura accademica L’anno accademico è suddiviso in due semestri: I Semestre (autunnale) : ottobre – gennaio (4 mesi) II Semestre (primaverile) : marzo – maggio (3 mesi) E prevede due sessioni d’esame: Invernale : gennaio/febbraio Estiva : giugno/luglio e settembre *Si consiglia di controllare la durata di ogni semestre prima di fare domanda per qualsiasi mobilità Erasmus per studio. Gli studenti ricevono credenziali di accesso al portale di Humanitas University dall’Ufficio Erasmus e possono iscriversi agli esami secondo le scadenze stabilite. Calendari delle lezioni e date degli esami sono disponibili sul portale dell’università. Conversione Voti : Grade distribution exam Grade distribution final degree Costi L’UE assegna a ciascun candidato selezionato una borsa di studio Erasmus+ , il cui importo mensile è stabilito annualmente dall’Agenzia Nazionale Erasmus+. La sovvenzione non copre la totalità delle spese, tuttavia si dimostra un utile contributo per coprire costi aggiuntivi come le spese di viaggio o di soggiorno nel Paese ospitante. Sono inoltre previsti fondi specifici per studenti con disabilità. L’accreditamento Erasmus rilasciato dalla Commissione europea è disponibile ai seguenti link: Carta dello Studente Erasmus Hunimed Erasmus Charter for Higher Education 2021-2027 Hunimed Erasmus Policy Statement 2021-2027 Erasmus Play Erasmus Play è un motore di ricerca per alloggi studenteschi in tutta Europa che permette di confrontare rapidamente e facilmente tutte le sistemazioni disponibili. Inoltre, consente di prenotare in tutta sicurezza, poiché tutti gli alloggi sono verificati al 100%. Il processo di prenotazione è molto semplice: Selezionare la destinazione e le date Confrontare le soluzioni disponibili Cliccare e prenotare in modo sicuro e protetto Humanitas University è un ateneo internazionale dedicato alle Life Sciences, con sede a Milano, costruito a fianco dell’IRCCS Istituto Clinico Humanitas. all ‘Estero Humanitas University offre ai propri studenti l’opportunità di trascorrere un periodo di studio o di tirocinio all’estero, vivendo un’esperienza formativa che arricchisce il percorso accademico e personale. Studiare in un contesto internazionale permette infatti di prepararsi ad affrontare la professione con una prospettiva globale e rappresenta un’opportunità unica di crescita, grazie al confronto con culture e stili di vita differenti. International Office Email: international.office@hunimed.eu Telefono: 02 8224 2486 Orario: Lunedì – Giovedì dalle 9:00 alle 18:00 International Mobility Humanitas University offers three international mobility pathways. Erasmus+ Travel Grant VLSO Erasmus+ Humanitas University prepara i propri studenti ad affrontare le sfide della società europea, che pur restando legata alle proprie tradizioni è oggi sempre più coinvolta nei processi di globalizzazione. Per questo, l’Ateneo incoraggia la partecipazione ai programmi di mobilità, comprese le esperienze virtuali, rivolte sia a chi studia, sia al personale accademico. All’interno del programma Erasmus+ sono disponibili tre tipologie di mobilità internazionale: Scopri le tipologie di mobilità Erasmus+ Erasmus+ per Studio Consente di trascorrere un periodo di studi (da 2 a 12 mesi) presso un’università europea partner. Durante la mobilità lo studente può frequentare lezioni, sostenere esami, sviluppare un progetto di tesi o svolgere un tirocinio, purché le attività siano coerenti con il percorso accademico. Prima della partenza Digital Learning Agreement: compilazione tramite area riservata MyPortal Accordo di Mobilità Form di rimborso Durante la mobilità, il primo e l’ultimo giorno Certificate of stay (attestazione di inizio e fine tirocinio rilasciata dall’ente ospitante) Al rientro Inviare all’Ufficio Erasmus il Transcript of Records rilasciato dall’ente ospitante Compilare online il Rapporto Narrativo (EU Participant Survey) Per richiedere il rimborso Per mandare la documentazione dopo la selezione Per finalizzare il riconoscimento dei crediti Erasmus+ per Tirocinio Permette di svolgere un’esperienza di tirocinio presso un’istituzione estera. In alternativa, è possibile accedere al programma SEMP (Swiss-European Mobility Programme) , che supporta la mobilità con la Svizzera. Le spese di soggiorno e viaggio sono coperte da fondi federali e le mobilità seguono le linee guida dell’Agenzia Nazionale Svizzera Movetia, in base ai posti disponibili ogni anno. Prima della partenza Learning Agreement: da compilare tramite MyPortal Accordo di Mobilità Durante la mobilità, il primo e l’ultimo giorno Certificate of stay (attestazione di inizio e fine tirocinio rilasciata dall’ente ospitante) Al rientro Inviare all’Ufficio Erasmus il Traineeship Certificate rilasciato dall’ente ospitante Compilare online il Rapporto Narrativo (EU Participant Survey) Per richiedere il rimborso Per mandare la documentazione dopo la selezione Per finalizzare il riconoscimento dei crediti BIPs I BIPs (Blended Intensive Programmes) sono attività formative internazionali che uniscono collaborazione online e un breve periodo di mobilità all’estero, con un approccio “challenge-based”. Ogni programma prevede il riconoscimento di almeno 3 CFU e la partecipazione di almeno tre università europee. L’UE assegna a ciascun candidato selezionato una borsa di studio Erasmus+ , il cui importo mensile è stabilito annualmente dall’Agenzia Nazionale Erasmus+. La sovvenzione non copre la totalità delle spese, tuttavia si dimostra un utile contributo per coprire costi aggiuntivi come le spese di viaggio o di soggiorno nel Paese ospitante. Sono inoltre previsti fondi specifici per studenti con disabilità. Humanitas University integra questo sostegno offrendo una borsa di studio aggiuntiva raddoppiando l’importo ricevuto dagli studenti . Sono inoltre previsti contributi speciali per partecipanti con minori opportunità, assegnati da specifici fondi nazionali. Procedura di Partecipazione Gli studenti interessati a un periodo di mobilità Erasmus+ troveranno tutte le informazioni relative a requisiti e modalità di candidatura nel bando annuale HU Erasmus . Le domande devono essere presentate tramite l’area riservata My Portal, sezione “ Mobilità Internazionale ”. La graduatoria e le liste di attesa saranno pubblicate sul sito e comunicate via e-mail agli studenti selezionati, che dovranno poi fare riferimento al sito dell’università ospitante per informazioni pratiche su corsi, candidature, alloggi e servizi. Chi desidera rinunciare alla mobilità è tenuto a darne immediata comunicazione all’Ufficio Erasmus ( erasmus@hunimed.eu ), così da consentire la riassegnazione del posto ad altri studenti. Supporto Linguistico La Commissione Europea offre agli studenti Erasmus+ corsi linguistici online e gratuiti , tramite “ Online Linguistic Support ” (OLS), piattaforma web accessibile con le credenziali fornite dall’Ufficio Erasmus. Si tratta di un’opportunità che consente agli studenti di proporre il proprio progetto presso un ateneo o un centro di ricerca internazionale, oppure di usufruire del supporto dell’Università nell’individuazione di un partner idoneo. In quest’ultimo caso, possono essere richiesti ulteriori requisiti legati al percorso accademico. Scopri le tipologie di mobilità Travel Grant Individuale Travel Grant Individuale. Partner Gli accordi Travel Grant Partner sono attivi solo per i corsi di laurea magistrale a ciclo unico in Medicina e Chirurgia e MEDTEC School. Accordi di Scambio Studenti Western University, London, Canada SickKids Hospital, Toronto, Canada Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, USA Universidade Federal Do Rio Grande Do Sul, Porto Alegre, Brasile University of Sao Paulo Medical School FMUSP, San Paolo, Brasile WOLFSON Medical Center, Israele University of Illinois Chicago, USA La domanda di iscrizione deve essere inviata dall’ufficio internazionale delle università partner all’indirizzo international.office@hunimed.eu . Come Candidarsi Gli studenti interessati devono presentare una breve sintesi del progetto al Presidente del Corso di Laurea. Una commissione di docenti, valuterà la qualità scientifica e gli obiettivi formativi della proposta e deciderà se possiede i requisiti per essere finanziata. I progetti approvati riceveranno un contributo commisurato alle spese di viaggio, vitto e alloggio, nei limiti stabiliti dal bando annuale. Bando Travel Grant – Partner Universities a.a 2024/2025 Criteri di Selezione Nel caso in cui le risorse disponibili siano inferiori al numero di progetti idonei, i fondi saranno assegnati seguendo le seguenti priorità: Considerazione del merito accademico (voti e CFU acquisiti) in caso di parità Precedenza a chi è iscritto al 4°, 5° e 6° anno Precedenza a chi partecipa per la prima volta Esclusione degli studenti che hanno già beneficiato della borsa due o più volte Documenti Per i progetti approvati, gli studenti dovranno fornire all’ufficio internazionale la lettera di accettazione rilasciata dall’istituto straniero. I progetti privi di tale documento non saranno considerati. Importo L’ammontare del contributo varia in base al Paese di destinazione ed è specificato nel bando. L’indennità viene erogata al termine del progetto, previa consegna di: Relazione finale del progetto da redigersi entro tre settimane del rientro Certificato attestante l’effettuazione del progetto, rilasciato dall’ente ospitante. Il certificato deve essere presentato entro 3 settimane dalla fine dell’esperienza Partecipare alla riunione di debriefing del programma Travel Grant Program per discutere dell’esperienza e di ulteriori miglioramenti Humanitas University è un ateneo internazionale dedicato alle Life Sciences, con sede a Milano, costruito a fianco dell’IRCCS Istituto Clinico Humanitas. all ‘Estero Humanitas University offre ai propri studenti l’opportunità di trascorrere un periodo di studio o di tirocinio all’estero, vivendo un’esperienza formativa che arricchisce il percorso accademico e personale. Studiare in un contesto internazionale permette infatti di prepararsi ad affrontare la professione con una prospettiva globale e rappresenta un’opportunità unica di crescita, grazie al confronto con culture e stili di vita differenti. International Office Email: international.office@hunimed.eu Telefono: 02 8224 2486 Orario: Lunedì – Giovedì dalle 9:00 alle 18:00 International Mobility Humanitas University offers three international mobility pathways. Erasmus+ Travel Grant VLSO Erasmus+ Humanitas University prepara i propri studenti ad affrontare le sfide della società europea, che pur restando legata alle proprie tradizioni è oggi sempre più coinvolta nei processi di globalizzazione. Per questo, l’Ateneo incoraggia la partecipazione ai programmi di mobilità, comprese le esperienze virtuali, rivolte sia a chi studia, sia al personale accademico. All’interno del programma Erasmus+ sono disponibili tre tipologie di mobilità internazionale: Scopri le tipologie di mobilità Erasmus+ Erasmus+ per Studio Consente di trascorrere un periodo di studi (da 2 a 12 mesi) presso un’università europea partner. Durante la mobilità lo studente può frequentare lezioni, sostenere esami, sviluppare un progetto di tesi o svolgere un tirocinio, purché le attività siano coerenti con il percorso accademico. Prima della partenza Digital Learning Agreement: compilazione tramite area riservata MyPortal Accordo di Mobilità Form di rimborso Durante la mobilità, il primo e l’ultimo giorno Certificate of stay (attestazione di inizio e fine tirocinio rilasciata dall’ente ospitante) Al rientro Inviare all’Ufficio Erasmus il Transcript of Records rilasciato dall’ente ospitante Compilare online il Rapporto Narrativo (EU Participant Survey) Per richiedere il rimborso Per mandare la documentazione dopo la selezione Per finalizzare il riconoscimento dei crediti Erasmus+ per Tirocinio Permette di svolgere un’esperienza di tirocinio presso un’istituzione estera. In alternativa, è possibile accedere al programma SEMP (Swiss-European Mobility Programme) , che supporta la mobilità con la Svizzera. Le spese di soggiorno e viaggio sono coperte da fondi federali e le mobilità seguono le linee guida dell’Agenzia Nazionale Svizzera Movetia, in base ai posti disponibili ogni anno. L’UE assegna a ciascun candidato selezionato una borsa di studio Erasmus+ , il cui importo mensile è stabilito annualmente dall’Agenzia Nazionale Erasmus+. La sovvenzione non copre la totalità delle spese, tuttavia si dimostra un utile contributo per coprire costi aggiuntivi come le spese di viaggio o di soggiorno nel Paese ospitante. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. Further details can be found in the call for applications Fees and Scholarships PhD students are required to pay an annual fee for access and attendance, set at €250,00 for the academic year 2025/2026 , including the regional tax and stamp duty. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. Further details can be found in the call for applications Fees and Scholarships PhD students are required to pay an annual fee for access and attendance, set at €250,00 for the academic year 2025/2026 , including the regional tax and stamp duty. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. Further details can be found in the call for applications Fees and Scholarships PhD students are required to pay an annual fee for access and attendance, set at €250,00 for the academic year 2025/2026 , including the regional tax and stamp duty. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. Further details can be found in the call for applications Fees and Scholarships PhD students are required to pay an annual fee for access and attendance, set at €250,00 for the academic year 2025/2026 , including the regional tax and stamp duty. PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) Places 4 Duration 3 Years Language English The joint PhD Programme in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering (PRIME) , based on the well-established partnership between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano , aims to train a new generation of researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering, clinical research, and health sciences. This highly interdisciplinary programme equips students with the knowledge and skills needed to tackle current and future healthcare challenges, with a strong focus on precision medicine and further research developments to support sustainable and equitable healthcare. CALL FOR APPLICATIONS Call for Applications a.y. 2025/2026 Bando di Concorso a.a. 2025/2026 RANKING LIST Final Ranking List First Ranking List Oral Interviews Calendar – September 2025 Programme Overview The PhD builds on the close collaboration between Humanitas University and Politecnico di Milano, both internationally recognized for excellence in education and research. This partnership allows students to engage in joint research projects and benefit from co-supervision by experts from both institutions. The programme also encourages international experiences, with opportunities to carry out research abroad or in collaboration with major industry partners, thanks to established connections with leading research and clinical institutions, hospitals, and companies worldwide . For those interested in leading innovation at the intersection of engineering and medicine, the PRIME PhD Programme offers a dynamic and stimulating academic environment to develop advanced expertise and make meaningful contributions to the future of personalized healthcare. The educational path combines engineering, biology, medicine, and data science, enabling students to develop innovative solutions that enhance diagnostics, therapies, and patient care. Research projects cover a broad range of topics, such as digital health, omics, biomaterials, biosensors, artificial intelligence, computational modeling, and medical devices. Each student follows a personalized research track, focusing on either computational modeling and AI or medical technologies and systems. The standard duration of the program is three years. PhD candidates will engage in research addressing fundamental biomedical science or clinical challenges, exploring both basic and applied medical sciences. Students will bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and practical clinical solutions, gaining advanced knowledge of techniques such as in vivo, in vitro, in silico, and artificial intelligence, as well as their integration into the development of new medical technologies. Research areas include, but are not limited to, digital health, omics, cell-based models, physiological systems, biomaterials, and biosensors. The program offers two main paths: one focused on computational modeling and AI techniques, and the other on medical technologies, devices, and systems. This dual-path approach ensures that graduates are well-equipped to innovate across a wide range of healthcare technologies and treatment strategies. PhD candidates will conduct studies, publish their findings in peer-reviewed journals, and submit their doctoral dissertation for approval by the PhD Board and two external referees. PhD Coordinator: Prof. Maurizio Cecconi Maurizio Cecconi Full Professor Anaesthesia and Intensive Care View Profile Places available 4 places The number of available places and/or scholarships may increase in the event that external funding becomes available by the deadline set for the completion of the call application procedure. Language English Duration 3 years Beginning of teaching activities 1 st December 2025 Application deadline 18 th July 2025 Documents Academic Regulations Research Doctorate (EN) Regolamento Corsi di Dottorato di Ricerca (ITA) Contacts For further information you can contact phd@hunimed.eu Didactic Activities To strengthen their research skills, during the first 2 years, PhD candidates are expected to attend core courses. In addition, PhD candidates will be able to attend other courses within Inter, Multi and Trans-disciplinary activities offered by both universities or external institutions. They also participate in seminars, workshops, and international conferences to enrich their scientific knowledge and professional skills. Each student is supported by a supervisor and a tutor and is responsible for developing and completing an original research project that bridges basic science and clinical application. Career Opportunities Choosing to pursue a PhD in Personalized caRe and Innovation in Medicine and Engineering opens up a wide range of career opportunities, both within and beyond academia. While many graduates choose to continue in university research and teaching, an increasing number are building successful careers in clinical research centers , hospitals , diagnostic labs , biotech and pharmaceutical companies , public health organizations , private industry , creation of start-ups and spin-offs . The growing emphasis on research and innovation in the private sector has led many companies to seek highly trained professionals, creating new roles where PhD graduates can apply their advanced skills and expertise. This diverse career landscape allows students to shape their professional paths according to their interests—whether in academic research, healthcare, industry, or entrepreneurship. Career opportunities may include: Universities and Research Institutions Hospitals and Healthcare Facilities Diagnostic and Testing Laboratories Public Health Agencies Regulatory Consulting Firms Clinical Research Organizations (CROs) Pharmaceutical, Biotech, and Medical Device Companies Healthcare Technology and IT Firms Telemedicine Providers Health Insurance Companies Health Data Analytics Organizations Genomics and Personalized Medicine Companies Start-ups and Spin-offs in the Biomedical Field Admission Requirements Admission is open to Italian and international candidates holding a Master’s degree with at least five years of university education. Candidates may be admitted to the PhD programme without age or nationality restrictions. Knowledge of the English language is required through language certification assessed by the Commission or achievement of a degree in English. Selection is based on the evaluation of the academic curriculum, a letter of motivation and an interview. Further details can be found in the call for applications Fees and Scholarships PhD students are required to pay an annual fee for access and attendance, set at €250,00 for the academic year 2025/2026 , including the regional tax and stamp duty.
